questions.question:
Two different positions of the same dice are shown having numbers 13 to 18. Find the number on the face opposite the face showing '16'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/918b0746f2bb467a60754d3898b6aadcc15b6ea2f8117dad28189d85bbdbee78.png]
questions.solution:
As 17 and 18 are the common faces on both the dice, the remaining faces are opposite to each other.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fc4dc0544daa68c8bff57c848aeb0dc2e370af5c037bb01522c4f101a508a75d.png] 

Therefore, '13' is the number on the face opposite the face showing '16'.

Hence, ‘**13**’ is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number and sixth number is related to fifth number.

9 : 56 :: 12 : ? :: 5 : 12
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic:** (First number - 1) × (First number - 2) = Second number

 
• 9 : 56 → (9 - 1) × (9 - 2) = 8 × 7 = 56
 
• 5 : 12 → (5 - 1) × (5 - 2) = 4 × 3 = 12

Similarly,

 
• 12 : ? → (12 - 1) × (12 - 2) = 11 × 10 = 110

Hence, '**110**' is the correct answer.

questions.question:
If ‘+’ means ‘-’, ‘÷’ means ‘+’, ‘-’ means ‘×’, and ‘×‘ means ‘÷’. Which of the following will be the value of the expression?

45 × 5 + 27 ÷ 81 - 3
questions.solution:
**Symbols**

 
 
 
+

 
 
 
÷

 
 
 
-

 
 
 
×

 
 
 

 
 
**Meaning**

 
 
 
-

 
 
 
+

 
 
 
×

 
 
 
÷

 
 
 

Given equation: 45 × 5 + 27 ÷ 81 - 3

After replacing the symbols by their meaning, we get:

__**45 ÷ 5**__ - 27 + __**81 × 3**__

= __**9**__ - 27 __**+ 243**__

= __**252 - 27**__

= 225

Hence, '**225**' is the correct answer.

questions.question:
‘Intelligent’ is related to ‘Foolish’ in the same way as ‘Expert’ is related to ‘________’.

(The words must be considered as meaningful English words and must not be related to each other based on the number of letters/number of consonants/vowels in the word)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic:** Words are antonyms of each other.

 
• ‘Intelligent’ is related to ‘Foolish’ → Intelligent is antonym of Foolish.

Similarly,

 
• 'Expert’ is related to ‘________’ → Expert is antonym of Amateur.

Hence, '**Amateur**' is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Three statements are given followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All mirrors are combs.

All clips are combs.

All combs are brushes.

**Conclusions:**

I. All clips are brushes.

II. All mirrors are brushes.

III. Some brushes are clips.

options.text: Only conclusions I and II follow
Only conclusions I and III follow
Only conclusions II and III follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram is: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e4a7f6b1868385b8af5b5f70ee8434f1a7c16003ceb7fda1988c95c08262bed3.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All clips are brushes. → **Follows** (As, All clips are combs and All combs are brushes)

II. All mirrors are brushes. → Follows (As, All mirrors are combs and All combs are brushes)

III. Some brushes are clips. → Follows (As, All clips are combs and All combs are brushes)

Hence, '**All conclusions follow**' is the correct answer.
